# cUtilitiesTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [cUtilitiesTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/cUtilitiesTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The kinematics functions of exudyn.cUtilities (#2960), checked by what they mean: rotation matrices are
#           orthogonal, each conversion and its inverse give back the input, the G matrices map the time derivatives
#           of the rotation parameters to the angular velocity, Skew gives the cross product; and what they refuse
#           (a ValueError). The result sums the values of all functions for fixed inputs, which are the same bits on
#           every platform.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-10-11
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
import exudyn.cUtilities as cu
import numpy as np
from exudyn import cMath #the math functions of the C++ code, the same bits on every platform

errors = 0
tolerance = 1e-14

def Check(condition, what):
    global errors
    if not condition:
        errors += 1
        exu.Print('cUtilitiesTest failed:', what)

def Close(a, b, what, tol=tolerance):
    Check(np.allclose(a, b, rtol=0, atol=tol), what)

v = np.array([0.3, -0.7, 1.1])
w = [0.2, 0.5, -0.4]                        #a list is as good as an array
rot = np.array([0.4, -0.3, 0.8])            #Tait-Bryan angles
rot_t = np.array([-0.5, 0.9, 0.2])
ep = cu.RotXYZ2EulerParameters(rot)
A = cu.RotXYZ2RotationMatrix(rot)

#rotation matrices: orthogonal, and the same from every parametrization
for (name, R) in [('RotXYZ', A), ('EulerParameters', cu.EulerParameters2RotationMatrix(ep)),
                  ('RotationVector', cu.RotationVector2RotationMatrix(v)), ('ExpSO3', cu.ExpSO3(v)),
                  ('RotationMatrixX', cu.RotationMatrixX(0.7))]:
    Close(R.T @ R, np.eye(3), name + ' orthogonal')
Close(cu.EulerParameters2RotationMatrix(ep), A, 'RotXYZ2EulerParameters and RotXYZ2RotationMatrix')
Close(cu.RotationMatrixX(rot[0]) @ cu.RotationMatrixY(rot[1]) @ cu.RotationMatrixZ(rot[2]), A, 'A = Ax*Ay*Az')
Close(cu.ExpSO3(v), cu.RotationVector2RotationMatrix(v), 'ExpSO3 and RotationVector2RotationMatrix')
Close(cu.RotationMatrix2D(0.7), cu.RotationMatrixZ(0.7)[0:2, 0:2], 'RotationMatrix2D')

#each conversion and its inverse
Close(cu.RotationMatrix2RotXYZ(A), rot, 'RotationMatrix2RotXYZ')
Close(cu.RotationMatrix2EulerParameters(A), ep, 'RotationMatrix2EulerParameters')
Close(cMath.norm(cu.RotationMatrix2EulerParameters(1.001*A)), 1., 'RotationMatrix2EulerParameters normalizes')
Close(cu.RotationMatrix2RotationVector(cu.RotationVector2RotationMatrix(v)), v, 'RotationMatrix2RotationVector')
Close(cu.LogSO3(cu.ExpSO3(v)), cu.Skew(v), 'LogSO3')
Close(cu.ComputeRotationAxisFromRotationVector(v), v/cMath.norm(v), 'ComputeRotationAxisFromRotationVector')
zyz = cu.RotationMatrix2RotZYZ(A)
Close(cu.RotationMatrixZ(zyz[0]) @ cu.RotationMatrixY(zyz[1]) @ cu.RotationMatrixZ(zyz[2]), A, 'RotationMatrix2RotZYZ')
zyz = cu.RotationMatrix2RotZYZ(A, flip=True)
Close(cu.RotationMatrixZ(zyz[0]) @ cu.RotationMatrixY(zyz[1]) @ cu.RotationMatrixZ(zyz[2]), A, 'RotationMatrix2RotZYZ flip')

#the G matrices: omega = G*theta_t, and the time derivatives by central differences
h = 1e-6
A_t = (cu.RotXYZ2RotationMatrix(rot + h*rot_t) - cu.RotXYZ2RotationMatrix(rot - h*rot_t))/(2*h)
Close(cu.Skew2Vec(A_t @ A.T), cu.RotXYZ2G(rot) @ rot_t, 'RotXYZ2G', 1e-8)
Close(cu.Skew2Vec(A.T @ A_t), cu.RotXYZ2GLocal(rot) @ rot_t, 'RotXYZ2GLocal', 1e-8)
Close(cu.RotXYZ2G_t(rot, rot_t), (cu.RotXYZ2G(rot + h*rot_t) - cu.RotXYZ2G(rot - h*rot_t))/(2*h), 'RotXYZ2G_t', 1e-8)
Close(cu.RotXYZ2GLocal_t(rot, rot_t), (cu.RotXYZ2GLocal(rot + h*rot_t) - cu.RotXYZ2GLocal(rot - h*rot_t))/(2*h),
      'RotXYZ2GLocal_t', 1e-8)
omega = cu.RotXYZ2G(rot) @ rot_t
Close(cu.AngularVelocity2RotXYZ_t(omega, rot), rot_t, 'AngularVelocity2RotXYZ_t')
ep_t = cu.AngularVelocity2EulerParameters_t(omega, ep)
Close(cu.EulerParameters2G(ep) @ ep_t, omega, 'AngularVelocity2EulerParameters_t and EulerParameters2G')
Close(cu.EulerParameters2GLocal(ep) @ ep_t, A.T @ omega, 'EulerParameters2GLocal')

#skew matrices: the cross product; 3n vectors and matrices of 3n rows
Close(cu.Skew(v) @ w, np.cross(v, w), 'Skew')
Close(cu.Skew(np.array([v]).T), cu.Skew(v), 'Skew of a (3,1) array')
Close(cu.Skew2Vec(cu.Skew(v)), v, 'Skew2Vec')
se3 = np.zeros((4, 4))
se3[0:3, 0:3] = cu.Skew(v)
se3[0:3, 3] = w
Close(cu.Skew2Vec(se3), np.concatenate([w, v]), 'Skew2Vec of se(3)')
Close(cu.Skew(np.concatenate([v, w])), np.vstack([cu.Skew(v), cu.Skew(w)]), 'Skew of a 6-vector')
M = np.array([np.concatenate([v, w]), np.concatenate([w, v])]).T          #6 rows, 2 columns
Close(cu.Skew(M), np.block([[cu.Skew(v), cu.Skew(w)], [cu.Skew(w), cu.Skew(v)]]), 'Skew of a 6x2 matrix')

#basis vectors
B = cu.ComputeOrthonormalBasisVectors(v)
Close(B @ B.T, np.eye(3), 'ComputeOrthonormalBasisVectors orthonormal')
Close(B[0], v/cMath.norm(v), 'ComputeOrthonormalBasisVectors first vector')
Close(cu.ComputeOrthonormalBasis(v), B.T, 'ComputeOrthonormalBasis')
[v0, v1, v2] = cu.GramSchmidt(v, w)
Close(np.array([v0 @ v1, v0 @ v2, v1 @ v2, v1 @ v1]), [0, 0, 0, 1], 'GramSchmidt')

#what they refuse
for (name, Call) in [('Skew of 4 values', lambda: cu.Skew([1, 2, 3, 4])),
                     ('Skew2Vec of a 2x2 matrix', lambda: cu.Skew2Vec(np.eye(2))),
                     ('GramSchmidt of parallel vectors', lambda: cu.GramSchmidt(v, 2*v)),
                     ('GramSchmidt of a zero vector', lambda: cu.GramSchmidt([0, 0, 0], v)),
                     ('AngularVelocity2RotXYZ_t at the singularity', lambda: cu.AngularVelocity2RotXYZ_t(w, [0, np.pi/2, 0])),
                     ('RotXYZ2RotationMatrix of 4 values', lambda: cu.RotXYZ2RotationMatrix([1, 2, 3, 4])),
                     ('RotationMatrix2RotXYZ of a 3x2 matrix', lambda: cu.RotationMatrix2RotXYZ(np.zeros((3, 2))))]:
    try:
        Call()
        Check(False, name + ' was not refused')
    except ValueError:
        pass

#the values: the same bits on every platform
values = [cu.ComputeOrthonormalBasisVectors(v), cu.GramSchmidt(v, w), cu.Skew(v), cu.EulerParameters2G(ep),
          cu.EulerParameters2GLocal(ep), A, ep, ep_t, cu.RotationVector2RotationMatrix(v), cu.RotationMatrix2RotationVector(A),
          cu.ExpSO3(v), cu.LogSO3(A), cu.RotXYZ2G_t(rot, rot_t), cu.RotXYZ2GLocal_t(rot, rot_t), cu.RotationMatrix2RotZYZ(A),
          cu.AngularVelocity2RotXYZ_t(w, rot), cu.RotationMatrixX(0.7), cu.RotationMatrix2D(0.7)]
u = errors + sum(np.sum(np.abs(value)) for value in values)
exu.Print('cUtilitiesTest: errors', errors)
exu.Print('solution of cUtilitiesTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
